name: Quantity stepper
summary: Choose an amount with − and +. You can also type. The value stays between min and max.
use: Amount in the cart and on the product page.
avoid: Large numbers or money amounts: use Input with type number.
figmaProps: Default, Hover, Focus, Disabled, At minimum
reactProps: Accessible name, for example "Quantity Wool sweater".
behaviour: A typed value is checked on Enter or when you leave the field.
− is off at the minimum, + at the maximum.
a11y: Native number field: arrow up and down work.
The buttons have their own names and point to the field (aria-controls).
do: Give a label with the product name when there are several on one page.
dont: Allow 0 as a way to remove an item: use a remove button.
